style: Palette of molten orange and ember red heat, ash grey and concrete, high-visibility yellow accents, dusky violet sky.
notes: Rewrite (2026-10). All five images regenerated on Klein: the 2025 set showed a two-eyed green brute that read as a famous comic character rather than the design's cyclops, the story image showed the hero instead of the setting, and the feature image had text labels and alien energy the design doesn't have. The hero is described identically in every prompt. Image 1 was flagged once on Klein and came out with two eyes once, so it was rerolled on Nano Banana 2 Lite: gen ChainReactionDemolitionPunch --model nano-banana-2-lite --only 1, then finish ChainReactionDemolitionPunch --only 1.

images.prompt: Dynamic low angle wide shot at dusk on an empty fenced demolition site. A towering muscular cyclops superhero with stone grey skin and exactly one large round eye in the middle of his forehead (a true one-eyed cyclops face), wearing an orange hard hat, a yellow high-visibility vest and work gloves, lands a huge punch on the wall of a derelict grey concrete warehouse with boarded-up windows. Where the fist lands, the wall breaks open in a fan of glowing orange-hot stone fragments, and the old building is crumbling into pouring grey ash and dust. Construction cranes and orange safety fences around the site. No text, lettering or signatures anywhere.

Flat side view like a 2D game screen. A lone grey stone building of stacked blocky rectangles stands on brown earth against a plain dusk sky. A bright blast has torn into its lower left side: thousands of tiny glowing orange-hot particles spray through the stone in streaks, the stone around their paths melting into grey ash that pours down in sand-like streams, and small secondary explosions burst further up the building. Heaps of grey ash pile at its base.

Extreme close-up side view of a thick slab of grey stone being torn apart by heat, made of visible tiny square pixel-like grains. Streaks of white-hot glowing grains punch through the stone, and around each streak the stone glows orange, then red, then crumbles into falling grey ash. The glow spreads outward from grain to grain like a wave through the slab, and at its far edge a small pocket of stone bursts in a fresh orange explosion. Dark background.

Portrait cover composition, heroic low angle. A towering muscular cyclops superhero with stone grey skin and one single large round eye in the middle of his forehead, wearing an orange hard hat, a yellow high-visibility vest and work gloves, stands with one fist raised, glowing orange with heat. Behind him a tall building collapses into a cloud of grey ash and glowing embers against a dusky violet sky. Open sky at the top of the frame.

Establishing wide shot from a hillside at sunset over the edge of a big city. In the foreground a busy recycling yard: dump trucks and conveyor belts carry heaps of grey ash and rubble, workers in yellow high-visibility vests sort materials, cranes and silos. Behind it, a row of old empty concrete buildings waits for demolition, one already reduced to a smoking heap. On the road between them walks a towering muscular cyclops superhero with stone grey skin and one single large round eye, wearing an orange hard hat and a yellow high-visibility vest, small in the scene, heading to the next building. The modern city skyline glows beyond.
